regime_context: Coordination is best read as aligned-incentives: the Fed keeps hawkish optionality to protect its inflation mandate while the Treasury suppresses front-end yields structurally, and the administration wants lower real yields without cutting optics. The consensus still treats the Iran oil spike and >70% September-hike odds as a clean hawkish regime; revealed preference says energy and front-end Treasury flows are the tradable legs, while rate-sensitive duration remains two-sided.
regime_context_zh: 协调最好理解为激励一致：美联储保留鹰派选择权以维护其通胀使命，而财政部在结构上压低前端收益率，政府想要更低的实际收益率，但不要降息的表象。市场共识仍把伊朗油价飙升和9月加息概率超过70%当作纯粹的鹰派格局；但显示的偏好表明，能源和前端美债资金流才是可交易的路径，而对利率敏感的久期依然双向。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The ceasefire collapse and US strikes on Iran re-prime the energy rotation that was already the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026. The administration tolerates an oil spike so long as it does not break the refi math, because the haven bid supports the strong-dollar-while-cutting bridge; energy is the direct beneficiary.
theses.thesis_zh: 停火破裂与美国对伊朗的打击重新点燃了2026年第一季度本就是ETF资金流入最多的能源板块轮动。只要不破坏再融资计算，政府会容忍油价上涨，因为避险买盘支撑了“强势美元同时降息”的桥梁；能源是直接受益者。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire collapse declared 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday, energy was top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
Dollar/debt theater: strong dollar while cutting is the FX bridge
Recent track record: XLE overweight calls in September both hit
theses.dissent: A rapid diplomatic off-ramp or Iran de-escalation headline could unwind the risk premium as fast as it appeared; oil spikes also feed the very inflation the Fed is fighting, inviting a hawkish response that lifts real yields and caps energy multiples.
theses.dissent_zh: 快速的外交降级或伊朗局势缓和的新闻可能像风险溢价出现时一样快地将其抹去；油价飙升也在助长美联储正在对抗的通胀，招致鹰派回应，推高实际收益率并压制能源估值。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days without a new Iran escalation headline
falsifier.text_zh: 在未来30个交易日内，若无新的伊朗升级新闻，XLE跑输SPY超过5%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff stays in force and the Section 301 replacement is pending; the domestic semiconductor onshoring bid persists so long as the tariff handoff completes cleanly. The Fed's inflation-fighting posture does not undermine this industrial-policy lever, and the AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program adds a power-cost subsidy for domestic fabs.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税继续生效，且301条款替代方案悬而未决；只要关税交接顺利完成，国内半导体的在岸化买盘就会持续。美联储的抗通胀姿态不会削弱这一产业政策杠杆，而AI/关键基础设施反应堆计划为国内晶圆厂增加了电力成本补贴。
evidence: China theater: 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force; Section 301 replacement ~12.5% pending; SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind tariff-protection premium
Rotation targeted: domestic semiconductors/fabs proxied by SMH, SOXX
Open prediction: 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force and/or covered list expands
theses.dissent: The recent SMH overweight call missed by -0.26 in a similar setup; if the Section 301 handoff stalls or China offers a semiconductor concession in trade talks, the onshoring premium could compress quickly.
theses.dissent_zh: 近期在类似情境下的SMH超配判断以-0.26失误收场；如果301条款交接停滞，或中国在贸易谈判中提供半导体让步，在岸化溢价可能迅速压缩。

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms SPY by more than 4% before the Section 301 replacement is finalized
falsifier.text_zh: 在301条款替代方案最终确定之前，SMH跑输SPY超过4%

theses.subject: XOP
theses.thesis: The same Iran escalation that lifts XLE flows through even more violently to the upstream E&P names, which carry higher oil-price beta. The ceasefire collapse reactivated the exact supply-disruption premium that drove Q1 energy inflows, and XOP is the higher-beta expression of that rotation.
theses.thesis_zh: 推升XLE的同一伊朗升级因素对上游勘探开采股票产生更剧烈的传导，这些股票具有更高的油价贝塔。停火破裂重新激活了推动第一季度能源资金流入的供应中断溢价，而XOP正是该轮动的高贝塔表达。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: Brent spiked ~$80 intraday, rotation re-primed by ceasefire collapse
Rotation targeted: energy (oil & gas) proxied by XLE, XOP, factual mechanism, headline-fragile
theses.dissent: XOP's higher beta cuts both ways: a single de-escalation headline or SPR release would hit it harder than XLE, and the Fed's inflation-first stance makes a hawkish response to the oil spike the most likely policy counterweight.
theses.dissent_zh: XOP更高的贝塔是把双刃剑：单条降级新闻或战略石油储备释放对其冲击会比XLE更大，而美联储的通胀优先立场使对油价飙升的鹰派回应成为最可能的政策对冲。

falsifier.text: XOP lags SPY by more than 7% over the next 20 trading days
falsifier.text_zh: 在未来20个交易日内，XOP跑输SPY超过7%

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: The US strikes on Iran and the NATO structural spending super-cycle keep the defense bid intact regardless of oil-price outcomes; procurement and missile-defense supply chains are the most durable policy-backed flows in the current theater map.
theses.thesis_zh: 美国对伊朗的打击与北约结构性支出超级周期使防务买盘不受油价结果影响；采购和导弹防御供应链是当前地缘版图中最持久的政策支撑资金流。
evidence: NATO/Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle, factual budget basis, defense primes + missile defense targeted
Iran/Middle East theater: defense bid persists regardless
theses.dissent: A prior ITA overweight call missed by -0.125 despite the same structural logic; if Congress delays the FY2026 defense appropriations or the Iran conflict freezes into a de facto ceasefire, the defense bid could stall while SPY grinds higher.
theses.dissent_zh: 此前基于同样结构性逻辑的ITA超配判断以-0.125失误；如果国会推迟2026财年防务拨款，或伊朗冲突冻结为事实上的停火，防务买盘可能停滞而SPY走高。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by more than 5% over the next 40 trading days
falsifier.text_zh: 在未来40个交易日内，ITA跑输SPY超过5%
